swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): The line segment AB and the line segment BA are the same. Reason (R): A line segment is determined only by its two end points, regardless of the order in which they are named.

add.q: Assertion (A): The line segment PQ has two end points, P and Q. Reason (R): Two lines meeting at a right angle are called perpendicular. Choose the correct option.
add.a: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
o: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Two angles drawn with arms of very different lengths can still be equal. Reason (R): The size of an angle is measured by the amount of turn between its arms, not by how long the arms are drawn.

add.q: Assertion (A): When angle ABC is placed over angle PQR with vertex B on vertex Q and arm BA on arm QP, and arm BC falls inside angle PQR, then angle PQR is the larger angle. Reason (R): Two angles can only be compared by superimposition if their arms are drawn to exactly the same length. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A full turn is divided into 360 equal parts rather than, say, 100. Reason (R): 360 can be evenly divided by many small whole numbers such as 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10 and 12, which 100 cannot.

add.q: Assertion (A): A full turn measures 100 degrees. Reason (R): A straight angle measures 180 degrees and a right angle measures 90 degrees. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is false, R is true
o: A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
